name: call_unrecovered_jump_target
description: Makes an indirect call through a jump table whose destination could not be recovered, so the real target is unknown from this code alone. It does nothing else and returns.

name: read_global_masked_flags
description: Reads a 32-bit global value, clears bits four to six of its lowest byte, and returns the result. No other state is changed.

name: store_stack_word_to_global
description: Copies the 16-bit value passed on the stack into a global variable and returns. No other memory or registers are written.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the constant zero and performs no other work. It reads and writes no data.

name: set_flag_in_struct
description: Sets bit one in the byte at offset 14 of the structure whose pointer is in address register A1. No other fields are changed.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns straight away without touching any data or calling anything.

name: call_subroutine_and_return
description: Calls a single unnamed subroutine with no arguments and returns when that call finishes. It adds no logic of its own beyond forwarding control.

name: store_register_to_global
description: Copies the 32-bit value in data register D0 into a global variable. It performs no other observable work.

name: copy_global_then_call_indirect
description: Copies one global variable into another, then makes an indirect call through a jump table whose target could not be recovered. The routine only forwards control to that unknown handler.

name: copy_struct_byte_to_base
description: Copies one byte from the structure addressed by A0 at offset six into memory at offset 2048 from base register A6. Nothing else is written.

name: check_global_constant
description: Compares a global variable with the constant 135168 and returns 4 if they are equal, otherwise 1. The global itself is not modified.

name: initialize_pointer_chain
description: Writes minus two into the slot addressed by A3, then stores the address of the next slot into offset 132 of the structure in A4 and offsets 50 and 54 of the structure in A2. It also writes minus two into that next slot and clears a word at offset 386 of the structure in A4.

name: copy_nested_pointer_fields
description: Reads the pointers held at offsets four and eight of the source structure and copies the 32-bit value at offset four of each pointed-to structure into offsets 50 and 54 of the destination. Each copy runs only when its source pointer is non-zero.

name: return_minus_one_if_nonzero
description: Returns minus one when the input value in D0 is non-zero and zero when it is zero, producing a full-width mask from a single test.

name: compute_table_derived_value
description: Derives one value from a three-entry global table: the third entry divided by 50, added to 60 times the sum of the second entry and 1440 times the low word of the first entry. The result is stored at offset 198 of the structure addressed by A2.

name: dispatch_status_by_flags
description: Clears the status byte at offset 31 of the structure in A1, then sets it to 29 when a flag at offset 64 is set. Otherwise it calls a table handler when the byte at offset 29 equals 2, sets status 28 when a bit of a global mask is clear, or writes a digit and calls a second handler; the status byte is returned.

name: toggle_byte_flag
description: Flips the top bit of the byte at offset 65 in the structure addressed by A3. It returns minus one when that bit was clear before the flip and zero when it was set.

name: store_inverted_bit_test
description: Stores 255 at offset 32 of the structure addressed by A1 when the bit numbered by the byte at offset 67 of A3 is clear in a global mask, and zero when that bit is set.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without touching any data. It is called by one other routine.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without touching any data. It is called by one other routine.

name: signal_pending_bit_event
description: Clears one bit in a global flag byte, selected by the byte at offset 67 of A3, and only when that bit was set does it mark bit one at offset 64. Each pass increments the counter at offset 294 and calls a handler, and the routine makes a second such call after clearing the mark again.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without touching any data. It is called by one other routine.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without touching any data. Four other routines call it.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only undecodable bytes, so the decompiled flow stops immediately and no behaviour can be recovered. It is called by two other routines.

name: load_executable_from_allocated_block
description: Allocates a memory block through the system library, issues two library I/O requests on a request record, and clears a fixed block of longwords. It then sets flag bits and walks AmigaDOS hunk records to load the executable's sections.

name: load_hunk_sections
description: Parses an AmigaDOS executable hunk table: code and data hunks are copied word by word into memory, and BSS hunks are zero-filled. Relocation entries add the base address to listed longwords, and any unrecognised hunk type ends the routine.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without touching any data.

name: initialize_channel_records
description: Fills four 38-byte channel records with default flags, pointers and a handler address taken from a fixed table. The first call also builds a table of entries from a source list.

name: reset_channel_state_flags
description: Clears nine state flag bytes and writes a sequence of values into the audio control shadow, ending with zero. It returns no value.

name: update_audio_channel_playback
description: Advances playback on four audio channels, loading each channel's sample pointer and length into the audio registers when its countdown expires. It follows a per-channel command stream that can change volume, period and loop state, and returns when the stream ends.

name: shift_serial_bit_register
description: Shifts one bit between two 16-bit shift registers held in memory, taking the bit from bit six of a value built from a global byte. It returns that value multiplied by four.

name: advance_audio_channel_state
description: Counts down a per-channel timer and, when it reaches zero, reloads four words from a source record into the audio channel's pointer, length, period and volume registers. Otherwise it advances the channel's fixed-point position by a step value, applying a second accelerated step on its own countdown.

name: clear_bit_and_set_flags
description: Clears one bit in the byte addressed by A4, with the bit number taken from D4, and sets bits one and five in the byte at offset one of the structure in A2. It returns a combined value built from D0 and a longword read from A6.

name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the byte in D0 without changing it. It is a pass-through of its single register input.

name: set_fixed_bits_in_byte
description: Sets bits zero, two, four, five and six of the byte in D0 and returns the result. The other bits are kept as they were.

name: set_fixed_bits_in_byte
description: Sets bits zero, two, four, five and six of the byte in D0 and returns the result. The other bits are kept as they were.

name: set_fixed_bits_in_byte
description: Sets bits zero, two, four, five and six of the byte in D0 and returns the result. The other bits are kept as they were.

name: check_hunk_header_and_call
description: Makes one indirect call through a function pointer, then checks whether the first longword is the AmigaDOS hunk header marker and begins hunk handling if it is. The decoded flow ends in undecodable data, so the rest of the routine could not be recovered.

name: initialize_custom_chip_state
description: Runs a fixed-length delay loop, stores the custom chip base address and several structure pointers in its stack frame, then calls helper routines and copies their results back into structure fields. Only part of its flow could be recovered from the decompiled code.

name: call_library_with_saved_registers
description: Saves its registers on the stack, calls a helper and then two function pointers taken from a structure at fixed offsets, and restores the registers afterwards. The decompiled code is too fragmented to say more about the final result.

name: wait_for_raster_position_sync
description: Polls the raster position register until its value passes a fixed threshold, then sets a flag word and stores a set of pointers into a structure. The decompiled output shows only part of the flow.

name: clear_buffer_and_set_pointers
description: Zero-fills a buffer whose length is taken from D0, then calls a helper. Unless that helper returns one, it stores a set of pointers into a structure, each computed as a base value plus a fixed offset.

name: initialize_structure_pointer_table
description: Stores a long list of pointers into a structure, each one a base address plus a fixed offset, and fills a block of 64 words with the value 65280. It then sets further pointer fields and calls helper routines.

name: pack_condition_flags_into_global
description: Builds a flag byte from the extend, negative and zero conditions of D0, stores it together with the upper word of D0 into a global variable, and increments that variable. It returns D0 unchanged.

name: advance_positions_until_limit
description: Steps two 16-bit position fields forward by four until they pass the limit 159, calling a helper on each step. It then runs a countdown loop and a fixed sequence of helper calls, and clears a flag byte.

name: advance_positions_and_wrap_row
description: Adds eight to a position field and, after sixteen steps, wraps it to the next row and resets two fields to 160. It then steps two other positions by four while a helper returns non-zero, and runs a countdown loop.

name: step_positions_then_countdown
description: Steps two position fields by four until a helper returns zero or the position reaches 160. It then runs a countdown loop and a fixed sequence of helper calls, and clears a flag byte.

name: finish_sequence_state_reset
description: Sets a position field to 276 and clears a flag byte, then runs a helper in a loop while cycling a field through the values four down to one. It finally clears two state bytes.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four unnamed routines one after another and then returns. It handles no data of its own.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four unnamed routines one after another and then returns. It handles no data of its own.

name: fill_grid_with_sequence_values
description: Waits briefly, then fills a grid of 16-bit cells with values from a pseudo-random sequence whose seed is read from two CIA register bytes. The fill repeats until a flag bit is set or a counter runs out.

name: fill_grid_with_sequence_values
description: Repeats the grid-filling pattern of its neighbour: a short wait, then 16-bit cells are filled from a pseudo-random sequence seeded from CIA registers, looping until a flag or counter ends the fill.

name: call_helpers_and_clear_field
description: Calls a helper, then two function pointers taken from a structure at fixed offsets, and clears a 16-bit field. It finishes with a four-pass loop of helper calls.

name: poll_until_flag_then_call
description: Repeats a loop until the flag byte at offset 1349 becomes non-zero. Each pass polls a helper until it returns zero, then calls another helper seven times.

name: poll_until_flag_then_call
description: Repeats a loop until the flag byte at offset 1349 becomes non-zero. Each pass polls a helper until it returns zero, then calls another helper seven times.

name: poll_until_flag_then_call
description: Repeats the same polling loop as its neighbours, waiting on the flag byte at offset 1349 and calling helpers in fixed counts. It touches custom chip state only through those helpers.

name: setup_blit_transfer_sequence
description: Waits while a busy bit in the byte at offset two of the block in A3 is set, then writes a set of word fields and pointers. It starts three further transfers, each preceded by the same wait.

name: walk_entry_lists_with_helper
description: Clears three state fields, then walks two lists of three-word entries, calling a helper for each entry until a negative entry ends the list. Other helper calls surround these loops.

name: select_buffer_and_compute_offset
description: Chooses one of two buffer pointers according to bit zero of a flag byte, then stores that pointer minus forty times the row number into a structure field.

name: process_hunk_records_with_helpers
description: Makes ten helper calls while comparing record types against AmigaDOS hunk codes, which marks it as part of executable loading. The decompiled output is too fragmented to recover the full algorithm.

name: call_vtable_with_saved_frame
description: Saves a frame of registers on the stack, makes a call through a function pointer taken from a structure, and restores the registers afterwards. The decompiled body is truncated, so the rest of the algorithm is not recovered.

name: call_vtable_with_saved_frame
description: Repeats the register-frame pattern of its neighbours: it saves registers, makes a call through a structure's function pointer, and restores them. The decompiled output is truncated before the routine ends.

name: call_vtable_with_saved_frame
description: Repeats the register-frame pattern of its neighbours: it saves registers, makes a call through a structure's function pointer, and restores them. The decompiled output is truncated before the routine ends.

name: call_vtable_with_saved_frame
description: Repeats the register-frame pattern of its neighbours: it saves registers, makes a call through a structure's function pointer, and restores them. The decompiled output is truncated before the routine ends.

name: return_stack_argument_unchanged
description: Returns the eight-byte value passed on the stack without changing it. Three other routines call it.

name: format_number_as_decimal_text
description: Fills a seven-byte buffer with the less-than character, then writes the decimal digits of the value in D0 by repeated division by powers of ten from one hundred thousand down, suppressing leading zeros. The text ends with the final digit followed by a zero character.

name: format_number_as_decimal_text
description: Continues a decimal conversion using a different register layout: it writes the digits of D1 by repeated division by powers of ten, skipping leading zeros, then writes the remaining value in D0 followed by a zero character.

name: advance_ring_buffer_entry
description: Advances a pointer field through a ring of entries, wrapping at two fixed end addresses and skipping one position when a flag word is zero. It clears a byte in the new entry while a further routine runs, then restores that byte.

name: copy_fixed_block_to_buffer
description: Copies a fixed block of 154 bytes from a constant source address into a buffer in the structure addressed by A5, then points an index field at the buffer start. It makes further calls only in one branch and clears a flag byte at offset 1441.

name: load_graphics_view_and_copper
description: Calls two graphics library functions through the library base, one of them loading a view, and stores pointers in the structure. The hardware facts show it also touches the copper list pointer registers.

name: install_copper_list_view_state
description: Looks up a graphics structure through the library base and records its pointers, loading the view on the first pass. A later pass takes a different branch, and the routine finishes by storing a state field and clearing a flag byte.

name: set_flag_and_copy_value
description: Sets a flag byte to one and copies one global value into another. It does nothing else.

name: build_copper_entry_block
description: Fills four list entries with computed addresses spaced 8960 bytes apart and stores the first entry's address. It then copies a block of 58 longwords from a global into the destination and copies ten words from the source at offset 170.

name: build_copper_entry_block
description: Performs the same block build as its neighbour: four computed entries spaced 8960 bytes apart, a 58-longword copy from a global, and ten words copied into the destination at offset 170. It then makes one further call.

name: toggle_saved_pointer_state
description: Toggles a saved-pointer state: when the flag at offset 132 is set, it restores the pointer from offset 128 into offset 438 and clears the state; otherwise it saves the pointer from offset 124 and sets the state.

name: setup_interrupt_server_node
description: Initializes an interrupt-server node with a handler address and a priority byte of 127, then either records a stored handler pointer or calls a library function. The interrupt label text in the binary reads as a vertical-interrupt name.

name: access_interrupt_request_register
description: The hardware facts show this routine touches the interrupt request register and calls one tiny routine that sets a bit in D1. The decompiled output was unavailable, so its exact sequence is not recovered.

name: reinstall_interrupt_server_node
description: Calls a library function to detach the stored interrupt-server node when its pointer is zero, then sets the node's handler and priority fields. It calls the library again to re-add the node and otherwise returns the value five.

name: copy_block_to_two_buffers
description: Calls another routine, then copies 32 words from a structure field into two destination buffers. The destination addresses come from pointer fields at offsets 124 and 128 of the structure.

name: clear_structure_word_block
description: Zeroes a block of 32 words starting at offset eight of the structure addressed by A5, then calls one other routine.

name: clear_sixteen_word_block
description: Zeroes sixteen words starting at offset eight of the structure addressed by A5, then calls one other routine and returns the value in D0.

name: decrement_nibble_matching_entries
description: For each level from fifteen down to one, decrements every one of 32 words whose low, middle or high nibble equals that level. It calls three other routines once per level.

name: decrement_entries_by_level_count
description: Repeats the nibble-matching decrement pass for a level count supplied in D6, calling three other routines per pass. It makes one final call after the loop ends.

name: return_stack_value_after_call
description: Calls one other routine and then returns the eight-byte value passed on the stack unchanged.

name: increment_entries_matching_nibbles
description: For each level from fifteen down to one, increments the destination word for every one of 32 source words whose low, middle or high nibble is at least that level. It calls three other routines per level.

name: decrement_sixteen_entry_nibbles
description: For each level from fifteen down to one, decrements every one of sixteen words whose low, middle or high nibble equals that level. It makes one call per level and one more after the loop.

name: copy_words_into_block
description: Copies 32 words from the source address passed in A0 into the structure block at offset eight, then calls one other routine and returns D0.

name: increment_sixteen_entry_nibbles
description: For each level from fifteen down to one, increments the destination word for each of sixteen source words whose nibble is at least that level. It calls another routine once per level.

name: decrement_sixty_three_nibbles
description: For each level from fifteen down to one, decrements each of 63 words in the block at offset 1486 whose low, middle or high nibble equals that level. It calls another routine once per level.

name: increment_sixty_three_nibbles
description: For each level from fifteen down to one, increments each of 63 words in the block at offset 1486 whose nibble is at least that level, copying its source from a global table. It calls another routine once per level.

name: clear_and_copy_display_tables
description: Clears a block of 64 words at offset 1486, copies a 364-byte table from a global into the structure at offset 1758, and copies five longwords into split high and low words at offset 1928. The hardware facts show it also touches the sprite position and copper pointer registers.

name: copy_word_blocks_with_delay
description: Copies a 32-word block between two offsets of the structure, then copies two further 16-word blocks, and finishes with a short delay loop.

name: increment_state_byte_return_zero
description: Increments the byte at offset 1326 of the structure addressed by A1 and returns zero. When a global flag is set, it triggers a trap instead.

name: read_mouse_joystick_state
description: Reads the mouse and joystick port movement registers, with the choice driven by a status field, and compares the bits against a previously stored value. The decompiled output is truncated before its full logic, which also reads the CIA fire-button port.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without touching any data. It is called by one other routine.

name: wait_for_byte_change
description: Spins in a loop that waits on the byte at offset 1326 of the structure addressed by A5. As decompiled, the loop compares that byte with itself, so the condition that ends the wait is not visible.

name: call_routine_count_times
description: Calls one other routine repeatedly, counting down from the low word of D0. It runs one more time than its starting count, because the loop stops only after the counter wraps past zero.

name: store_cia_port_bytes
description: Stores a combined 16-bit reading of two CIA port bytes into the structure field at offset 1072 and returns D0 unchanged.

name: generate_scaled_random_value
description: Advances a 16-bit pseudo-random seed stored at offset 1072 with a multiply-and-add step, then maps the seed into the range from the low word of D1 up to the value in D2 and returns that result.

name: show_status_text_sequence
description: Large routine of 321 instructions that calls seventeen unnamed routines and reads CIA registers. It refers to the text strings GET, READY and PLAYER, and the decompiled output does not show the full flow.

name: dispatch_hunk_record_type
description: Calls three other routines and compares record types against AmigaDOS hunk codes, which marks it as part of executable loading. The decompiled output is truncated, so its full logic is not recovered.

name: handle_press_fire_prompt
description: Large routine of 329 instructions that calls nineteen unnamed routines and refers to the text PRESS FIRE TO PLAY and to the file name record.dat. The decompiled output is truncated, so its full flow is not recovered.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without touching any data. It is called by one other routine.

name: set_status_bits_and_mask
description: Sets bits two, four and five of the byte at offset 64 of the structure in A0, then returns the byte in D0 with bits zero to five set.

name: return_constant_four
description: Returns the constant four and performs no other work.

name: swap_buffer_with_fixed_area
description: Clears the flag word at offset 430, then exchanges 512 words between a fixed area at offset 460 and the buffer addressed by the pointer at offset 420. The old contents of the fixed area are written to the buffer addressed by the pointer at offset 424.

name: toggle_buffer_swap_direction
description: Toggles the flag word at offset 430 and exchanges 512 words between a fixed area and one of two buffers, with the direction chosen by the new flag value.

name: configure_blitter_row_loop
description: Programs the blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, size and control registers, then runs a loop of 200 operations. Each operation's source and destination come from two structure fields, chosen by a flag bit.

name: configure_blitter_for_transfer
description: Programs the blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers for a single transfer. It checks the blitter's busy state before the transfer starts.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after another and then returns. It handles no data of its own.

name: run_four_blit_transfers
description: Programs the blitter's mask, modulo, control and source registers, then starts four transfers of the same fixed size. Each destination address is advanced by 8960 bytes, and each transfer waits while a busy flag is set.

name: advance_counted_table_entries
description: Walks a table of counted entries: each entry's counter is decremented, and when it reaches zero the entry moves to its next value, wrapping at a stored limit. It calls four other routines during the walk.

name: call_fixed_address_five_times
description: Calls the routine at a fixed address five times in a row and then returns.

name: sync_paired_state_bytes
description: Compares two pairs of state bytes. When a byte in a pair differs from its partner, it copies the first byte into the second and calls another routine.

name: call_routine_with_address_pairs
description: Makes two calls to another routine, each with a pair of address constants, and then makes three further calls with no arguments.

name: call_fixed_address_six_times
description: Calls the routine at a fixed address six times in a row and then returns.

name: adjust_clamped_level_byte
description: When three state bytes are clear, adds the value in D0 to the level byte at offset 1246 and clamps the result between minus one and twenty-four. A negative result also makes a call and sets a countdown byte at offset 1356 to 30.

name: sync_state_bytes_countdown
description: Compares ten state bytes against a mirrored set, and each byte that differs is copied across and triggers three calls. It then counts down a timer word at offset 1094 and, when it reaches zero, clears a status byte at offset 1335.

name: emit_decimal_digits_of_value
description: Converts the value in D7 to decimal by subtracting powers of ten from one hundred thousand down to one. It calls another routine for each digit it emits.

name: emit_decimal_digits_from_field
description: Converts the 32-bit value stored at offset 888 of the structure in A5 into decimal digits. It calls another routine for each emitted digit and once more at the end.

name: classify_digit_character
description: Converts the low byte of D2 by subtracting the ASCII zero code, remapping it through a lookup table when a flag is set. It then calls one of two routines depending on whether the value is ten or eleven.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after another and then returns. It handles no data of its own.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after another and then returns. It handles no data of its own.

name: emit_string_characters

name: emit_string_characters
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, skipping carriage-return characters, and calls another routine for each remaining character.

name: walk_byte_data_with_handlers
description: Large routine of 301 instructions that walks byte data and calls eight unnamed routines. The decompiled output is truncated before its full flow, so the detailed logic is not recovered.

name: blit_rows_with_busy_waits
description: Programs the blitter's mask, modulo, control and size registers, then runs 169 transfers. Each transfer waits on the blitter's busy status, and the source and destination addresses advance between passes.

name: run_guarded_blit_transfers
description: When the flag byte at offset 1234 is not one, programs the blitter's mask, modulo and control registers and starts four transfers spaced 8960 bytes apart. Each transfer waits for the busy flag to clear.

name: run_guarded_blit_transfers

name: call_one_routine_and_return

name: call_one_routine_and_return

name: run_paired_blit_transfers

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after another and then returns. It handles no data of its own.

name: run_blit_transfer_series
description: Programs the blitter's mask, modulo and control registers, then runs 192 transfers from a pointer, waiting on the busy flag around each one.

name: fill_longs_with_minus_one
description: Fills 2240 longwords, starting at offset 35360 of the structure addressed by A1, with the value minus one.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after another and then returns. It handles no data of its own.

name: run_fixed_size_blit_loop
description: Programs the blitter's mask, modulo, control and size registers, then runs 56 transfers of a fixed size. The destination advances on each pass, and the busy flag is checked before every transfer.

name: stub_unrecovered_body_return
description: The decompiled output shows no work for this routine and returns its register inputs unchanged. The listing has 64 instructions, so its full body was not recovered.

name: scan_bit_pattern_table
description: Scans a table of shifted 16-bit words while tracking a running value in D5, calling two other routines within the loop. The decompiled output is truncated before the loop finishes, so its exact result is not recovered.

name: process_bit_stream_loop
description: Runs a loop that shifts bits out of a value held in an input register and calls two other routines. The decompiled listing is truncated before the loop's exit condition is fully visible.

name: accumulate_sum_with_calls
description: Loops adding two 16-bit values into a running sum and masking the result, calling three other routines per pass. The decompiled listing is truncated before the loop's exit is fully visible.

name: run_counted_state_loop
description: Decrements a loop counter on each pass and, when its low byte reaches minus four, clears two state bytes at offsets 12 and 13 of the structure in A0. It calls two other routines inside the loop.

name: clear_two_state_bytes
description: Zeroes the two state bytes at offsets 12 and 13 of the structure addressed by A0 and returns.

name: store_three_state_bytes
description: Stores the low bytes of D5, D6 and D7 into offsets 20, 12 and 13 of the structure addressed by A0.

name: reset_playback_fields
description: Sets a word at offset 1080 to six, sets a flag byte at offset 1242 to one and a counter byte at offset 1245 to 24, and copies two words from offsets 1004 and 1006 into offsets 996 and 998.

name: clear_playback_state_fields
description: Clears the flag byte at offset 1242 and the counter byte at offset 1245, then copies two words from offsets 1000 and 1002 into offsets 996 and 998.

name: select_state_value_by_flags
description: Chooses a value from several state fields according to flag bytes and a level byte, then calls two other routines. The decompiled listing is partly truncated, so the complete selection logic is not recovered.

name: configure_blitter_row_draw
description: Checks state bytes, then programs the blitter's masks, modulo, pointers, control and size registers and makes one call. Its loop and size selection are partly truncated in the decompiled output.

name: set_flag_bit_and_call
description: Sets bit zero of the byte at offset 1338 of the structure addressed by A5, then calls one other routine.

name: configure_blitter_for_position
description: Computes a blit address from two position fields and a row stride, checks a column threshold, and programs the blitter's full register set before waiting on it. The decompiled listing is partly truncated, so the complete sequence is not recovered.

name: handle_overlapping_instruction_body
description: Routine of 147 instructions that other routines call and that calls five others. The decompiler reports overlapping instructions and bad data in it, so its behaviour cannot be recovered from this listing.

name: advance_object_position_and_flags
description: Adds per-object signed step bytes to two position words of the structure at A0, and sets a third field when a bounds comparison holds. It calls one other routine for matching flag states.

name: advance_object_position_and_flags
description: Applies the same position update as its neighbour, with the bounds comparison made without the offset subtraction. It calls one other routine for matching flag states.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
